SELECT o.*, p.name partner, dp.name dest, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(qty,0) * COALESCE(price,0), 2)), 0) FROM order_lines l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) total,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_lines l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) lines
     FROM orders o LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN points dp ON dp.id = o.dest_point_id
     WHERE o.company_id = ? AND (o.point_id = ? OR o.dest_point_id = ?) ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT o.id, o.number, p.name partner, d.name dest FROM orders o LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN points d ON d.id = o.dest_point_id ORDER BY o.id DESC
